_comment: Scripted hermetic delivery/tracker responses for this kit's billed run. Per the wf-fake contracts (capabilities/fake/fragments/{tracker,delivery}.ops.md): an object of exactly {by, map, default?} is an ARGUMENT-KEYED response (the arg named by `by` selects from `map`) — used for ops whose concurrent callers make call order nondeterministic (`get` is keyed by id so a caller asking for one child never receives the umbrella record). A JSON ARRAY is an ordered sequence indexed by the count of PRIOR calls to that same (surface, op) pair, blind to arguments; past the end the last element repeats (`pr-detect` starts found:false so a shipper must actually perform pr-create rather than adopting a pre-existing PR). Any other scalar or object value is returned for every call. Every value below is a real response the harness returns as-is — verify the observed call order against this file during the cheap gate phase before any billed run, and reorder a sequence to match rather than inventing a new one. Every string here is also scanned by the blinding gate, so no wording drawn from this kit's declared vocabulary may appear. **Model:** claude-fable-5

FLEET-1.title: Fixture umbrella
FLEET-1.description: A two-child fixture slice the harness drives end to end. It exists so the scripted response sequence below has a real shape to answer, and carries no wording drawn from this kit's declared vocabulary.

FLEET-2.title: Fixture child — declared interface file
FLEET-2.description:
Type: chore

Objective

Add one declared interface file to a skill folder so the harness has a small, self-contained unit of work to drive through its phases.

Scope

In: add the interface file and its declaration. Out: any behavior change, any version bump.

Success criteria

Given the interface file is added, when the repository's marker lint runs, then it passes.

FLEET-3.title: Fixture child — reference stub
FLEET-3.description:
Type: chore

Objective

Add one reference stub beside an existing skill so the harness has a second independent unit of work to drive in parallel with the first.

Scope

In: add the reference file and the row that names it. Out: any behavior change, any version bump.

Success criteria

Given the reference file is added, when the repository's declared-paths check runs, then every named path resolves.
